description: GNN + study harness: gnn.py (heterogeneous PyG HeteroData link predictor with message passing + dot-product decoder, BCE over sampled negatives, early stopping on the drug-wise validation split, fixed seeds; ALL torch/PyG imports LAZY so the module imports cleanly on the classical venv and raises a clear install message only when training is invoked); ablations.py (matrix over +genes/+structure/+TG-GATEs and graph-vs-non-graph, 5 seeds, 95% bootstrap CIs over held-out drugs, skipping GNN/structure cells gracefully when deps are absent and labeling them skipped); error_analysis.py (breakdowns by term frequency, drug class, and label sparsity). Depends on FEAT-001 (graph) and FEAT-002 (metrics + baselines).
steps: Read research/kg/.agents/plan.md and context.json FIRST, plus FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings.

Create research/kg/gnn.py (`[kg.gnn]` style) with NO top-level torch/torch_geometric import. Add _require_torch() that attempts the import and raises RuntimeError with a clear message pointing to research/kg/requirements.txt and the separate PyG wheel + CPU-only torch step. Implement build_hetero_data(artifacts_dir) (lazy import inside), make_model(...) returning a hetero message-passing + dot-product-decoder link predictor (class defined inside the factory to keep import clean), sample_negatives(pos_edges,n_drugs,n_terms,ratio=1,seed=42) sampling from UNLABELED pairs (document PU), train_gnn(data,splits,epochs,patience,seed=42) with BCE + early stopping on drug-wise val, and score_all_pairs(model,data).

Create research/kg/ablations.py (`[kg.abl]` style): run_ablation_matrix(configs=['popularity','knn','logreg','mf','+genes','+structure','+tggates','graph','non-graph'], seeds=range(5), n_boot=1000) returning a results DataFrame with point + 95% CI columns per (config, seed), writing research/kg/artifacts/ablation_results.parquet. Cells requiring torch (GNN/graph) or RDKit (structure) must be recorded as status='skipped (dep absent)' rather than failing when the dep is missing.

Create research/kg/error_analysis.py (`[kg.err]` style): by_term_frequency(scores,edges,terms), by_drug_class(scores,edges,drugs_meta) bucketing null classes as 'unknown', by_label_sparsity(scores,edges); each writes research/kg/artifacts/error_analysis_*.parquet.

Create research/kg/tests/test_gnn_import.py asserting `import` of gnn.py succeeds WITHOUT torch installed and that calling train_gnn (or _require_torch) raises the clear install error. Create research/kg/tests/test_ablations.py asserting the results frame has a row per (config,seed) and that dep-absent cells are labeled skipped. Create research/kg/tests/test_error_analysis.py asserting group counts reconcile to totals. Provide __main__ assert-runners.
acceptance_criteria: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import importlib.util,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'research/kg'); import gnn" succeeds with torch absent (clean import).
Invoking gnn.train_gnn (or _require_torch) without torch raises a RuntimeError whose message names requirements.txt and the PyG wheel step.
ablations.run_ablation_matrix produces research/kg/artifacts/ablation_results.parquet with point+CI columns and GNN/structure cells marked 'skipped (dep absent)' on the current venv.
error_analysis writes the three breakdown Parquet files and group counts reconcile to totals.
verification: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest research/kg/tests/test_gnn_import.py research/kg/tests/test_ablations.py research/kg/tests/test_error_analysis.py  (fallback: run each directly with the venv python) — all pass
findings:
DONE & verified on the classical venv (no torch/PyG/RDKit installed). pytest: 12 passed (4 in test_gnn_import.py, 4 in test_ablations.py, 4 in test_error_analysis.py) in ~163s; the assert-based __main__ fallbacks exist in all three test files. Created research/kg/gnn.py, research/kg/ablations.py, research/kg/error_analysis.py and research/kg/tests/{test_gnn_import,test_ablations,test_error_analysis}.py. Tests sys.path.insert('..') so they run under pytest or direct `python tests/test_*.py`.

LAZY-IMPORT CONTRACT VERIFIED: `research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'research/kg'); import gnn"` -> 'IMPORT OK' with torch absent. gnn.py has NO top-level torch/torch_geometric import; _require_torch() is the single gate and raises RuntimeError(_TORCH_INSTALL_MESSAGE) which names 'research/kg/requirements.txt' AND the separate PyG wheel + CPU-only torch step (verified: message contains both 'requirements.txt' and 'torch_geometric'). build_hetero_data/make_model/train_gnn/score_all_pairs all `import torch`/`torch_geometric` INSIDE the function body; calling train_gnn with torch absent raises the clear install error before touching its args. NOTE: _TORCH_INSTALL_MESSAGE points at research/kg/requirements.txt, which is NOT created by this feature (it belongs to the later docs/requirements feature per plan.md step 10) -- the message is a forward pointer, not a hard dependency, and does not affect any FEAT-003 verification.

gnn.py SIGNATURES:
- _require_torch() -> (torch, torch_geometric) or raises RuntimeError with install guidance (module constant _TORCH_INSTALL_MESSAGE).
- sample_negatives(pos_edges, n_drugs, n_terms, ratio=1, seed=42) -> (m,2) int ndarray. PURE NUMPY (no torch) so it is unit-testable on the classical venv; PU pseudo-negatives from the unlabeled set, never overlapping positives; documented 'absent != negative'.
- build_hetero_data(artifacts_dir=None) -> PyG HeteroData (lazy import). Node types drug/term/gene with .node_id arange tensors + num_nodes; edge types ('drug','has_adr','term')+reverse and ('drug','assoc','gene')+reverse. Reads FEAT-001 artifacts (nodes_drug/term/gene, edges_drug_term/gene) by drug_index/term_index/gene_index.
- make_model(data, hidden_channels=64, seed=42) -> LinkPredictor instance. The nn.Module subclasses (GNNEncoder=2x SAGEConv wrapped by to_hetero; LinkPredictor=per-type nn.Embedding -> encoder -> dot-product decoder over (drug,term) pairs) are DEFINED INSIDE the factory to keep import torch-free.
- train_gnn(data, splits, epochs=50, patience=10, seed=42, neg_ratio=1, lr=0.01, hidden_channels=64) -> (model, history). BCE-with-logits over sampled negatives; early stopping on DRUG-WISE val AUC (resample held-out val-fold drugs); history is a list of {epoch,train_loss,val_auc}. `splits` is splits.drug_wise_split output ({'train','val','test'} of drug indices). Cold-start enforced: train positives are only edges whose drug is in splits['train'].
- score_all_pairs(model, data) -> dense (n_drugs,n_terms) numpy sigmoid matrix.

ablations.py: run_ablation_matrix(configs=('popularity','knn','logreg','mf','+genes','+structure','+tggates','graph','non-graph'), seeds=range(5), n_boot=1000, artifacts_dir=None, out_path=None) -> DataFrame AND writes research/kg/artifacts/ablation_results.parquet. One row per (config,seed). COLUMNS: config, seed, status, metric(='auroc'), point, ci_lo, ci_hi, n_test_drugs, n_boot, note. For each (config,seed) it builds a drug-wise cold-start split at that seed (over drugs with >=1 positive), fits the classical model on held_out_label_mask training edges, scores held-out TEST drugs (each drug = its positives + an equal count of PU pseudo-negative terms), and reports AUROC with a 95% bootstrap CI RESAMPLING TEST DRUGS via metrics.bootstrap_ci. DEP-ABSENT CELLS: config 'graph' (needs torch/PyG) and '+structure' (needs RDKit + feat_drug_structure.parquet, both absent) are recorded status='skipped (dep absent)', point/ci_lo/ci_hi=NaN, note=reason -- they do NOT fail the run. Verified on the venv: full 9-config matrix -> 7 classical configs 'ok', 'graph'+'+structure' skipped; parquet written with point+CI columns and both status values. '+genes' uses gene-Jaccard kNN; '+tggates' augments logreg features with feat_drug_tggates value columns (NaN->0, mask cols dropped); 'non-graph' = matrix_factorisation reference. _grouped_auroc pools (y_true,y_score) across resampled per-drug items.

error_analysis.py (torch-free): by_term_frequency(scores,edges,terms,out_dir=None), by_drug_class(scores,edges,drugs_meta,out_dir=None) (null/'' classes -> 'unknown' bucket), by_label_sparsity(scores,edges,out_dir=None,bins=(1,5,20,50,100)). Each GROUPS over the POSITIVE drug-term edges and asserts sum(group['n'])==len(edges) (reconciliation), then writes research/kg/artifacts/error_analysis_{term_frequency,drug_class,label_sparsity}.parquet. `scores` accepts EITHER a dict {(drug_index,term_index)->score} OR a 1d array row-aligned to `edges` (so GNN or baseline scores both work without importing torch). Verified end-to-end on real artifacts with the term-popularity scorer: term_frequency=79 bands, drug_class=27 classes, label_sparsity=6 bands, all reconciling to 140677 pairs. _freq_band maps numeric %% to common(>=10%)/infrequent(1-10%)/rare(<1%), passes textual bands through, missing->'unknown'.

PU CAVEAT documented in all three module docstrings (absent pair = unlabeled, not negative; AUROC is an optimistic upper bound). Fixed seed 42 throughout. Reads FEAT-001 artifact columns and reuses FEAT-002 metrics.bootstrap_ci + baselines.{term_popularity_prior,gene_jaccard_similarity,drug_similarity_knn,logistic_regression_baseline,matrix_factorisation,predict_scores}. Did NOT install torch/PyG/rdkit; did NOT modify engine/, frontend/, research/models/. Note: sklearn ConvergenceWarning on the logreg/+tggates baseline is benign (expected on this raw feature set).
